old_value: Archive operations distinguish several guarded outcomes. DAT parse failure reports an error and asserts. Public-symbol lookup always clears an output slot before lookup; missing symbols are either only reported or reported and asserted, depending on the wrapper used. Preload-aware loaders return true when the requested archive was already registered by the DVD layer and false when they had to allocate and load it, while still optionally returning the resulting descriptor. Archive release asserts that the descriptor is non-NULL and marked as independently owned before freeing it. Explicit relocation returns -1 for a NULL descriptor or a serialized-size/byte-order mismatch and returns 0 after successful section mapping and pointer relocation.
reason: Replace broad or incomplete wording with the cited mechanism and its explicit limits.
new_value: Fatal parsing and required-symbol misses report and assert; nonfatal symbol misses report and leave the destination NULL. Preload wrappers return true for cache reuse and false for fallback loading, not success or failure. Release checks the DONT_FREE flag but does not establish cache ownership. Explicit relocation rejects a null descriptor or declared-size mismatch, maps sections and mutates relocation words without comprehensive bounds validation.
